notes.title: Exciting News! Our Official Release Date is Set: April 4, 2025!
notes.content:
Dear players,  

Thanks to your incredible feedback from the demo, we've been hard at work fixing and improving many aspects of the game. Your insights have helped us refine the experience, and we can't wait for you to see the results!  

To show our appreciation for all the support, we’re adding brand-new scenes to the launch release, bringing even more depth and surprises to the story.  

Additionally, we’re introducing new features that, while not directly tied to the main gameplay, will enrich the game’s atmosphere and world-building—because immersion matters!  

The game will have a special launch discount 10% off for a week!

The countdown has begun! Add the game to your wishlist now to stay updated on all the latest news. The wait is almost over! 🚀🔥
